title: Covered Days and Units per Shipment for One Pet on a Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Household usage method — sizing an existing Tailwise Autoship to one pet**

1. The existing pet's usage is read from the subscription's own record: the units of its scheduled shipments charged in the last twelve months, divided by 52 weeks.
2. One unit lasts that pet 7 divided by that weekly usage, in days.
3. The days the existing pet's re-sized Autoship covers are the subscription's weeks between shipments multiplied by 7, plus a cushion of 14 days.
4. The units per shipment are those covered days divided by the days one unit lasts the existing pet, rounded up to a whole unit, never less than one unit and never more than the program's most units per shipment.

A record counts as dated in the last twelve months when its date is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the day the value is worked out.

## Worked example (hypothetical Autoship Everyday subscription on a 4-week frequency)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Units of scheduled shipments charged in the last twelve months | 26 |
| Weekly usage: 26 divided by 52 | 0.5 unit a week |
| Days one unit lasts: 7 divided by 0.5 | 14 days |
| Covered days: 4 weeks multiplied by 7, plus 14 | 42 days |
| Units: 42 divided by 14, rounded up | 3 units |

With 30 covered days instead, 30 divided by 14 is about 2.14, rounded up to 3 units; with 28 covered days, exactly 2 units.
